d:
The Vedas are the oldest records of human thought. The Upanishads are a distillation of Vedic teaching and primarily concerned with the Absolute from which all existence comes.
The concluding portions of each Veda contains unique literature, the Upanishads, since they come at the end, and contain the very essence of the Vedas; they are called the Vedanta - meaning the end of the Vedas.
